title: CIL Mode Switch Install Authority Receipt
description: Written at install time (Q4) by whoever performs the install, never by the package and never during evaluation. It records the claim that the evidence home is outside the evaluating actor's reach. The evaluator uses its presence and pin binding to decide whether an install is R1-b-qualified. It is a representation of the install boundary, not a proof of it: the package cannot distinguish this receipt from one a same-process actor wrote for itself, because proving that in-process needs an install-time signing key that this slice deliberately does not add.

installId.description: Must equal the installId of the INSTALL-PIN.json in the same home. Binds the receipt to one install rather than to the package.

boundary.description: The only value this receipt may carry. Absence of the receipt is UNPROVEN; there is no way to write UNPROVEN here, because an install that cannot make the claim simply does not write the file.

establishedBy.description: The installer or host identity that placed the evidence home and set CIL_MODE_SWITCH_EVIDENCE_HOME.

evidenceHomeControl.description: How the home is held outside the evaluating actor's reach: filesystem ownership and mode, container image layer, read-only mount, managed configuration, or equivalent. Stated so a reviewer can check the claim against the actual install.

evaluatorCanWriteEvidenceHome.description: The install asserts the evaluated process cannot write this home. A install that cannot assert this must not write the receipt.

evaluatorCanRedirectEvidenceHome.description: The install asserts the evaluated process cannot change CIL_MODE_SWITCH_EVIDENCE_HOME for its own evaluation.

note.description: Optional free text, for example naming a fixture as a model rather than a real install.
